title: Identification of risk factors and therapeutic approaches for sarcopenia and evaluation of a stepwise intervention to support the introduction of the ICD10 code for sarcopenia as a geriatric diagnosis with establishment of a patient registry
summary:
The sarcopenia (reduction of muscle mass and function) effects risk of falling, the course of many other diseases and physical activity and
independence. This risk is particularly associated with additional diseases such as osteoporosis, diabetes or dizziness.
The cause of the disease is still largely unclear and we hope to improve the course of the disease by early detection and better understanding of its causes.
Therefore, we want to examine this disease with tests and repeat these tests in annual intervals in order to determine the individual progression.

In the study, we want to jointly investigate which factors influence this disease
of old age and what therapeutic options are available for specific groups.
